title: Long time dreamer
content: But I just found out about this sub and I feel so much saner 🥹 I’ve been dreaming of these places for years. My main place is a hotel that has hallways that connect to other places, such as a theater, arcade, grocery stores, the mall, etc. I’ve been in an airport, on planes, downtown, literally everywhere. I did randomly stumble on these pictures of a mall like 2 years ago that I could swear I’ve been to in a dream, do they look familiar to anyone?
